title: A Mountain Parrot Did Math No Bird Had Done
subject: kea parrot

scenes.text: A mountain parrot just did something no bird had done before.
Kea from New Zealand were tested by the University of Auckland. Six birds, one trick, and a published result in 2020.
They learned that a black token meant food and an orange one meant nothing.
Then two rangers held mixed tokens. The kea picked the ranger more likely to hand over black, even when both held the same mix, by watching how he chose.
Researchers said it combined social cues with statistics, which no bird had shown before.
Another study found wild kea outscored gibbons, which are primates, on some tests.
